title: CI lint and vitest are continue-on-error while next build treats ESLint as a gate
blast: AGENTS.md and next.config.ts:32-37 say ESLint is a required build gate (ignoreDuringBuilds:false). .github/workflows/ci-gate.yml:78-91 still run npm run lint and npm run test:vitest with continue-on-error: true (vitest also `|| true`). Unit tests (node:test) are required. A PR can go red on vitest/lint in the log and still merge if tsc + test:unit + next build pass. Tenant-route grep is required but only covers a handful of APIs, not SSR pages. First beat never opened CI.
evidence: .github/workflows/ci-gate.yml:64-71 unit tests required; :78-91 lint + vitest continue-on-error; :108-112 verify-high-risk-tenant-routes required. next.config.ts:37 eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds false. scripts/verify-high-risk-tenant-routes.cjs has no app/admin/**/page.tsx list-loader checks.

title: Tenant CI grep never opens admin/counselor/employer SSR list pages
blast: scripts/verify-high-risk-tenant-routes.cjs is the only required tenant gate. It asserts fragments on selected API routes (members/route, metrics, counselor inactive, employer jobs, partner referrals, invite accept, merge, subgroups). It does not read app/admin/members/page.tsx, placements/page.tsx, training-progress/page.tsx, counselors/page.tsx, students/page.tsx, users/page.tsx — the pages staff actually load. Those pages can regress to unscoped findMany and CI stays green.
evidence: scripts/verify-high-risk-tenant-routes.cjs:33-117 API-only needles. rg training-progress|placements/page|members/page|counselors/page scripts/verify-high-risk-tenant-routes.cjs → no matches. app/admin/members/page.tsx has no organizationId.

title: No test asserts dashboard Prisma count, layout getUser skip, or apply org source
blast: High-severity claims from both beats have verify: rg, not a failing unit test. rg 'ensureAppUserProvisioned|dashboard/page' in *.test.ts / *.spec.ts is empty. apply signup tests mock getDefaultOrganizationId and never fail if someone keeps using default org. Rate-limit fail-open is untested for public voice. The ranker top slice can stay open forever without a red CI.
evidence: rg ensureAppUserProvisioned -g '*.test.ts' -g '*.spec.ts' → no product test (only getDefaultOrganizationId mocks). app/(portal)/dashboard/page.tsx prisma. count is 24; no test pins it. lib/member/ensureAppUser.ts has no colocated test file.

title: Kit lean paths are default but ?ui=legacy still ships the 5000-row scanners
blast: Comments say kit is default to avoid demo-DB stalls. The legacy branch is not deleted, not flagged, not admin-only. Bookmarks, shared links, and crawlers with ?ui=legacy reintroduce the 504 shape. First beat never opened employer/counselor homes.
evidence: app/(portal)/employer/page.tsx:63-64 v2 kit default; leftover take:5000 at :238 after the kit return. app/(portal)/counselor/page.tsx:61-62 kit default; :143-190 legacy take:5000. app/admin/counselors/page.tsx:60-76 legacy take:5000 partners.

title: fr and pt catalogs are live URLs but excluded from REVIEWED_LOCALES
blast: messages/fr.json 205017 bytes and pt.json 197129 bytes ship. APP_LOCALES includes fr/pt so /fr and /pt resolve; LanguageToggle only advertises en/es. Unreviewed copy on public apply/WIOA paths is a product-stakes risk (locked 'no cost to members' language). First beat counted 184KB en.json load cost only.
evidence: lib/i18n/config.ts:1-15 APP_LOCALES vs REVIEWED_LOCALES. wc -c messages/*.json. LOCALEABLE_PATH_PREFIXES includes /apply /wioa-qualification /login.

title: Caddyfile only proxies workforceap.mikeslabs.com with no security headers
blast: Self-host path (DEPLOY.md) uses Caddy. File is 19 lines: reverse_proxy localhost:3000, no header_up, no request body limits, no rate_limit. Next sets HSTS/CSP; Caddy does not add a second layer. Custom domains for tenant orgs have no Caddy example. Not a Vercel issue.
